verdict.rationale: Brave documents REST endpoints (curl examples) and an official MCP server (brave-search-mcp-server) for agent integration, plus OpenAI-SDK compatibility for the Answers endpoint, but there is no evidence of dedicated official client SDKs (Python/JS/Go packages) or a published OpenAPI spec — probes for openapi.json and docs.md both 404. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party language SDKs, published OpenAPI/spec artifacts, independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
